pages.accepted_text: ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT    e r    q    o  Liability Company with an address at 79 Metropolitan Ave, Brooklyn, New York, NY 11249 ("Owner"), and 66N3 Owner LLC, an New York Limited Liability Company with an address at c/o Flatiron Real Estate Advisors,LLC,119 West 23'1 Street, Suite 903,New York,New York 10011 ("Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is owner in fee of certain land in the Borough of Brooklyn, Kings County, City and State of NewYork known as Lot 22 in Block 2357on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork,and by the street addresses 83-85 Metropolitan Avenue,Brooklyn,NewYork and more particularly described in Schedule A annexed hereto and made a part hereof together with the buildings and improvements ("Owner's Building") now or hereafter located thereon ("Owner's Premises"); and WHEREAS,Developer is owner in fee of certain land in the Borough of Brooklyn,Kings County,City and State of NewYork known as Lot 12 in Block 2357 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and by the street addresses 62 North Third Street, Brooklyn, New York, respectively and more particularly described in Schedule B annexed hereto and made a part hereof together with the buildings and improvements ("Developer's Building") now or hereafter located thereon ("Developer's Premises"; and Owner's Premises and Developer's Premises are collectively referred to as the *Premises"); and WHEREAS, Developer may demolish or alter Developer's Building and construct a new building ("New Building") on Developer's Premises; and WHEREAS, Developer intends for the New Building to contain more Floor Area (as hereinafter defined) than is now permitted to be constructed on Developer's Premises pursuant to the Zoning Resolution if Developer's Premises were a separate zoning lot; and WHEREAS, Developer has determined there are approximately 7,738 square feet of Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant to Owner's Premises which exceed the Floor Area Development Rights currently utilized on Owner's Premises ("Excess Floor Area"); and WHEREAS, Owner desires to allow Developer the right to utilize the Excess Floor Area WHEREAS, Owner and Developer desire to alter the configuration of the Prior Zoning Lot (as defined herein) by subdividing said Prior Zoning Lot to reallocate the Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant thereto;
